disposition_reason: Reports cadmium, copper, lead, zinc and iron by AAS in pork and beef bought monthly for three months at a market in Okpuno, Nigeria.

study.design: market survey, monthly purchases over three months
study.market: a market in Okpuno, Awka South, Anambra State, Nigeria
study.period_text: January, February and March (year not stated)
study.method: oven-dried 105 C, HNO3/HClO4 wet digestion, AAS (Varian AA240)
study.qa: duplicate replicates; no CRM, recovery or blank reported

unresolved: Iron (about 0.2-0.4 mg/kg) and zinc (about 0.1-0.25 mg/kg) are far below usual levels in meat, which raises doubt about units or basis; recorded as printed.
Three-month SDs (e.g. pork Cd 0.04 ± 0.05) are larger than the spread of the monthly means; recorded as printed.
Collection year not stated (January to March); dry or fresh basis not stated although samples were oven-dried before digestion.
Beef zinc mean printed "0..21 ± 0.20" read as 0.21.
